upgrade.name: Ancient Invention blueprints (Howl's workshop)
upgrade.detail: Stormguard Citadel is Armadylean dig-site geography under Kandarin (wiki Equilibrium League tags all Stormguard hotspots Kandarin; Temple of Ikov entrance). Howl's Floating Workshop drafting bench + torn blueprint fragments are the self-sufficient no-trade path. Lowse at Armadyl's Tower (Asgarnia) is the Armadylean collector for related collections (Inspire Genius) — collector turn-in is separate from dig ownership. Do not invent fragment counts beyond wiki fragment costs (200 for targeted untradeable blueprint; 150 random). · Kandarin hard-gates Stormguard / Howl self-sufficient blueprint unlock. GE tradeable blueprints are not a League no-trade path. Invention Guild manufacture of shells/tools after unlock still pressures Asgarnia workbenches (support, not dig ownership). · Unlocks: Permanent discovery of ancient weapon / armour / tool gizmos (9-slot shells), Enhanced hammer-tron / pyro-matic / fishing rod-o-matic (level-80-class ancient tools), XP Capacitor 5000 blueprint, Theoretical blueprints path for Experimental Aether Reactor and Subtle Blade after Back to the Drawing Board research, Ancient component discovery (Classic/Historic 85, Vintage 94, Timeworn 103 Invention) for restored-artefact disassembly
requirements: 95 Archaeology for Howl's Floating Workshop / drafting bench path (self-sufficient)
Torn blueprint fragments (Howl's workshop) from Stormguard Citadel excavation (Kandarin)
85 Invention to use Ancient gizmos blueprint; 93 for Ancient tools; 106 for XP Capacitor
Tradeable GE blueprints exist for main-game buyers — no-trade League must self-craft at Stormguard

upgrade.name: Inspire Genius (Howl's Thinking Cap)
upgrade.detail: Stormguard dig collections (Kandarin) + Lowse Armadylean collector turn-in at Armadyl's Tower (Asgarnia). Planner-relevant permanent XP multiplier for production skills. Related Inspire Awe / Effort / Love are separate experience relics not expanded here. · Hard Kandarin for Armadylean III artefacts at Stormguard; hard Asgarnia for Lowse turn-in (Armadyl's Tower / Lowse stay Asgarnia — not moved with the dig). · Unlocks: Inspire Genius relic power, +2% XP in artisan skills: Crafting, Construction, Cooking, Firemaking, Fletching, Herblore, Runecrafting, Smithing
requirements: Kandarin: Armadylean III collection artefacts from Stormguard Citadel
Asgarnia: turn in to Lowse at Armadyl's Tower for Howl's Thinking Cap
118 Archaeology listed on relic; boosts can restore/excavate as early as ~110 with pulse cores
5,000 chronotes and 250 monolith energy to harness

upgrade.name: Divine Conversion (Cres Framework)
upgrade.detail: Stormguard / Howl's workshop is the hard Archaeology geography (Kandarin — wiki League badge). Guthixian Cache personality-transfer step is also Kandarin taxonomy. High-value Divination QoL for energy/charge loops. · Kandarin hard-gates dig artefacts + Cache step. Asgarnia is optional Invention workbench pressure for golem framework manufacture (Invention Guild stays Asgarnia) — not dig ownership. · Region chain (support pressure): kandarin / asgarnia · Unlocks: Divine Conversion relic power, Convert entire backpack of Divination memories (including familiar inventory) at an energy rift in one action, Does not work in Daemonheim
requirements: 98 Archaeology (boostable) for golem heart/instruction artefacts at Stormguard (Kandarin)
86 Invention (boostable) to manufacture golem framework (Asgarnia Invention Guild support)
85 Divination (boostable) for large memory transfer in Guthixian Cache (Kandarin)
Howl's Floating Workshop mystery; Back to the Drawing Board research; The World Wakes
2,000 chronotes and 100 monolith energy to harness

upgrade.name: Ancient Invention
upgrade.detail: Unlocks: Ancient weapon gizmo, Ancient armour gizmo, Ancient tool gizmo, Ancient tools blueprints, XP Capacitor blueprint · Source: Stormguard Citadel Dig Site / Howl's Floating Workshop (Kandarin League region). Self-sufficient no-trade path is Kandarin Archaeology; shell manufacture after unlock still uses inventor's workbenches (Asgarnia Invention Guild support).
requirements: 95 Archaeology for Howl's Floating Workshop mystery (Stormguard, Kandarin)

Shell discovery/manufacture is workbench Invention progression; natural hub is Invention Guild (Asgarnia). Ancient shells depend on Ancient Invention blueprints (kandarin:ancient-invention-blueprints — Howl's workshop at Stormguard Citadel Dig Site). Combat perk recipes stay in planner-expansions-invention-* — not duplicated here. · Asgarnia owns primary workbench/guild discovery geography.
